approved_amendments.scope: Prepare and stage this restoration-runner WCS and authority proposal only.
limits: This approval authorizes draft records only.
Runner implementation requires separate active EOS authority.
Do not modify execution/framework/runner.py or REP-STEWARD-028.
Do not merge, publish, deploy, or change production data.

execution.objective: Propose a reusable, fail-closed runner for restoring Founder-approved verified features, using the PR #7 dashboard candidate as its first qualification case.
success_criteria: Accept a manifest containing the approved decision, release contract, baseline, candidate, exact paths, patch checksum, and required checks.
Verify authority, candidate identity, patch checksum, path scope, and target-baseline compatibility before changing files.
Prepare restorations in an isolated worktree and report exact results.
Run only the checks required by the applicable release contract.
Create a restoration PR only after all required checks pass.
Never merge, publish, deploy, change production data, or silently expand scope.
Demonstrate a stop result when the release contract or active release gate is missing.
Do not modify the existing execution/framework/runner.py mutation engine.
execution.verification_profile: MANIFEST_VALIDATION; AUTHORITY_AND_CONTRACT_CHECK; EXACT_PATH_CHECK; ISOLATED_RESTORATION; REQUIRED_RELEASE_GATE; NO_MERGE_OR_DEPLOY

depends_on: A Hub-specific active work-cycle authority and applicable release contract must be issued before runner implementation.
The exact proposed runner paths must be reviewed before the WCS becomes active.
unlocks: A separate manifest-driven restoration run for PR #7 after authority and release-gate prerequisites pass.
Reuse of the qualified runner for later verified-feature restorations.

forbidden_surface: Dashboard application paths during runner qualification
